lessons.title: Will for Future, Promise, Offer, and Prediction
lessons.content: Will is used in future structures and for promises, offers, and predictions. The structure is Subject + will + V1.

details.explanation: 'Will' is used to talk about things that will happen in the future.
details.burmese: မနက်ဖန် အင်္ဂလိပ်နေ့ ဖြစ်မယ်။

details.explanation: 'Will' is used to make promises about the future.
details.burmese: ငါနင်ကို အမြဲချစ်မယ်။

details.example: That phone is ringing; I will go and answer it.

details.explanation: 'Will' is used to make predictions about the future.
details.example: We will have two extra lessons this afternoon.
details.burmese: ဒီနေ့လယ်ကျရင် ငါတို့ နောက်ထပ်သင်ခန်းစာ ၂ ခါ ရမယ်။

details.explanation: 'Will' can be used to give warnings.
details.example: Don't trust her, she will always tell you lies.
details.burmese: သူမကို မယုံနဲ့။ သူမက မင်းကို အမြဲလိမ်နေတယ်။

lessons.title: Will in Type 1 Conditional Sentences
lessons.content: Will is used in Type 1 conditional sentences, which describe real or possible future conditions. The structure is: If + present simple, will + V1.

details.explanation: Used for real or possible situations in the future. If the condition is met, the result will happen.
details.example: We will go fishing at the weekend if the weather is good.
details.burmese: ရာသီဥတု ကောင်းရင် ကျွန်တော်တို့ ငါးဖမ်းကြမယ်လေ။

details.explanation: Used for academic conditions as well.
details.example: If you study well, you will pass the exam.
details.burmese: မင်း စာလေ့လာရင် စာမေးပွဲ အောင်မှာပါ။

lessons.title: Would as Past Tense of Will
lessons.content: Would is the past tense form of will. It is used in reported speech and past narratives. The structure is Subject + would + V1.

details.explanation: When we report what someone said about the future in the past, we change 'will' to 'would'.
details.example: Jack said he would finish the work the next day.
details.burmese: ဂျက်က သူ နောက်နေ့ ပြီးအောင်လုပ်မယ်လို့ ပြောခဲ့တယ်။

details.explanation: Used in stories and past accounts of future intentions.
details.example: Ann said she would write us soon.
details.burmese: အန်က သူမ မကြာခင် ငါတို့ဆီ စာရေးမယ် ပြောခဲ့တယ်။

details.explanation: Used to describe what someone expected or hoped would happen.
details.example: He hoped she would come back.
details.burmese: သူမပြန်လာမယ်လို့ သူ မျှော်လင့်ခဲ့တယ်။

lessons.title: Would in Conditional Sentences
lessons.content: Would is used in Type 2 (unreal present) and Type 3 (unreal past) conditional sentences. These describe hypothetical or unreal situations.

details.explanation: Used for hypothetical situations in the present that are unlikely or unreal. If + past simple, would + V1.
details.example: I would phone Sue if I had her number.
details.burmese: ငါမှာ သူ သူမဖုန်းနံပါတ်ရှိခဲ့ရင် ဆူကို ဆက်မှာမှာ ပါ။

details.explanation: Used for hypothetical situations in the past that did not happen. If + past perfect, would have + V3.
details.example: If the weather had been good, we would have gone fishing on the weekend.
details.burmese: ရာသီဥတု ကောင်းခဲ့ရင် ကျွန်တော်တို့ ဒီတစ်ပတ်ငါးဖမ်းကြမှာ ပါ။

lessons.title: Would for Polite Requests
lessons.content: Would is more polite than will. It is used for polite requests and offers. The structure is Would + subject + V1?

details.explanation: Used to make polite offers and requests.
details.burmese: အခု ဖျော်ရည် သောက်ချင်လား။

details.example: I would like to eat sandwich.
details.burmese: ကျွန်မ ဆန်းဒ်ဝိုက် စားချင်တယ်။
